title: Messaging Email Received Event
description: A human chat message arrived on an email inbox. One type per platform: the platform is the entity segment (messaging.<platform>.received), so subscribers bind to exactly the platforms they care about, or to bloodbank.evt.messaging.*.received for all of them. ordering_key is thread:<thread_id>: every event of one platform-native conversation thread orders together. Consumers deduplicate on message_id. NOT telephony: PSTN-addressed communication (E.164 numbers, carrier SMS/RCS/MMS) is the telephony domain. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (messaging).

ordering_key.description: Section 11.1 bucket 'thread:<thread_id>', the same value as 'thread:' + data.thread_id: all events of one platform-native conversation thread order together.

direction.description: Whether the message arrived from a counterpart or was sent by the operator.

sender.description: Who sent the message, in platform terms.

handle.description: Platform address of the sender: email address, @username, or platform user ID.

display_name.description: Sender's display name, when the platform exposes one.

recipient.description: Who received the message, in platform terms.

handle.description: Platform address of the recipient: email address, @username, channel, or platform user ID.

display_name.description: Recipient's display name, when the platform exposes one.

text.description: Message body. Platforms and notifications may truncate long bodies.

received_at.description: When the platform received the message (source clock), RFC 3339.

message_id.description: Platform-native message ID; consumers deduplicate on it.

thread_id.description: Platform-native thread/chat ID; the ordering bucket names it.
